title: How to find the RIGHT person to follow up with after applying to a job 🔎
description:
Recruiters use search parameters to locate candidates for their open roles, so why not do the same and look for recruiters? You can type in a Boolean search string in the search bar using AND / OR to narrow search results. From there you can use filters to find recruiters based on location, company, type of recruiters. Being proactive in your job search is important and this is a great way to find contacts. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #linkedin #linkedintips
